title: Projected Inner-Function Dynamics and Crystalline Measures of Meyer-Blaschke type
summary: We generalize a construction of Yves Meyer of sparse crystalline measures arising from powers of a Blaschke factor. Starting from a recursion $f_n=θ^n f_0$ on the unit circle where $θ$ is an inner function, we project the Fourier coefficient array $\widehat{f_n}(k)$ to the real line by placing its entries at the frequencies $k+αn$.
